hedging_delta.evidence: Prior call was fairly confident; current adds 'have to be cautious about wafer demand projections' due to tariffs, more qualifiers on outlook.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q1'25 gross margin >25% and utilization ~70%; current Q1 actual margin came in at 26.7% with commentary of decline, and current-quarter guide of ~30% margin/mid-70% utilization is a recovery ask, not an increase versus the prior call's implied trajectory of steady improvement into 2025.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Prior call cited 22/28nm as 34% of revenue; current shows 22/28nm at 37% but 40nm-and-below overtaking as key metric, while CapEx held flat at $1.8B (no upward revision).

new_topic_rate.evidence: New emphasis on tariff impact on demand and cost-reduction/AI manufacturing initiatives not discussed in prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Prior call touted 'industry-leading' and steady 2025 growth outlook; current call stresses being 'cautious' and 'challenging environment' amid tariffs.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior call described 2025 as 'posted for another year of growth'; current call only expects 'moderate rebound' and flags caution on wafer demand due to tariffs.
